title: Prepaid balance: one wallet per agency for messages, numbers, calls and AI top-ups
goal: Let agencies pay in advance for usage beyond their plan, and refuse paid usage when the balance is empty.
why: COST-MODEL section 6.1 and ADR-001 section 7: SMS, marketing WhatsApp, calls, numbers and AI top-ups must come from one prepaid balance, never postpaid; R110 left the balance hook returning false.
steps: Master 0021: wallet_accounts (tenant_id PK, currency, balance REAL, low_balance_threshold REAL, auto_topup INTEGER, auto_topup_amount REAL), wallet_entries (id, tenant_id, kind topup|debit|refund|adjustment, amount REAL signed, balance_after REAL, reference, idempotency_key UNIQUE, created_at), usage_rates (key e.g. sms.IN, whatsapp_marketing.IN, ai_credit_pack.5000, unit_price REAL, currency, active) seeded from COST-MODEL 6.4 as inactive drafts.

wallet.ts: debit(env, tenantId, { amount, reference, idempotencyKey }) as one conditional UPDATE (balance >= amount) plus entry insert in a D1 batch; topup via billing checkout (one-time payment mode in both gateways) credited on the webhook; 80% and zero alerts via notification + email (sendTransactional).
meter.ts: when the allowance is exhausted, try wallet debit at usage_rates price; refuse with 402 BALANCE_EMPTY when that fails.

Desktop billing page: balance, top-up buttons (₹500/1,000/2,500 or $10/25/50 by currency), ledger list, low-balance setting; super admin manual adjustment endpoint in admin.ts is out of scope here (note as follow-up) unless trivial.
tests: backend/test/wallet.test.ts: parallel debits never overdraw; same idempotency key debits once; top-up webhook credits once; allowance exhausted + balance -> send allowed and debited; balance empty -> 402.
acceptance: No path debits without an idempotency key (code review).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
goLiveVerify: Owner approves retail usage_rates (G1 item 5/6 and COST-MODEL 6.4); refund policy in terms.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
New ids use generateId() (UUIDv7) from backend/src/utils/uuid.ts. D1 conventions: TEXT ISO dates, REAL money, TEXT JSON, INTEGER booleans.
